يبن (form I)
# يَبِنُّ (yabinnu) /ja.bin.nu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of بَنَّ (banna)
# يُبَنُّ (yubannu) /ju.ban.nu/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of بَنَّ (banna)
# يَبِنَّ (yabinna) /ja.bin.na/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of بَنَّ (banna)
# يُبَنَّ (yubanna) /ju.ban.na/: third-person masc
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
